CustomField.formula:
/* Initial formula IF( LEN( Phone) = 0, 0,20) + IF( LEN( Email) = 0, 0,20) + IF( LEN(MailingStreet) = 0, 0,20) + IF( LEN(Title) = 0, 0,20) + IF( ISPICKVAL(Salutation,""), 0,20) */
IF(OR(LEN(AccountId)=0,NOT(ISPICKVAL(Account.ER_Status__c,"Active"))),0,13.6363636363636) + IF(LEN(Email)=0,0,18.1818181818182) + IF(ISPICKVAL(ER_Role__c,""),0,13.6363636363636) + IF(LEN(FirstName)<=3,0,9.09090909090909) + IF(LEN(LastName)<=3,0,9.09090909090909) + IF(LEN(Phone&MobilePhone)=0,0,18.1818181818182) + IF(ISPICKVAL(Salutation,""),0,9.09090909090909) + IF(LEN(Title)=0,0,9.09090909090909)
CustomField.label: Data Quality Score
